name: Beyond the Dawn - Chenxi Xia de Zhongdian
original_name: Beyond the Dawn 晨曦下の终点
source:
After ending her many years of adventure, Minnie Pemesia decided to go to the Rocker Town to open a coffee shop. Since she met a weird man, everything changed...
